issue.title: Public Test: Scout MCP Generic Client Testing
issue.body:
We are calling on the public to test Scout MCP across arbitrary generic MCP Clients!

**Instructions:**
1. Configure your IDE or CLI MCP client with:
   ```json
   "scout": {
     "command": "npx",
     "args": ["-y", "open-source-scout-mcp@latest"]
   }
   ```
2. Restart your client.
3. Open any directory. Execute the `initialize_execution` tool to analyze the codebase.
4. Take screenshots of the output and logs.
5. Create a folder in `public-testing-reports` and submit a PR with your screenshots and a review!
